source_policy: Edit skills/<department>/<name> only; plugin and ZIPs are generated.

skills.name: daily-site-report-digest
skills.title: Daily site report and next-day priorities
skills.description: Draft a daily site report or consolidate site updates into an evidence-based exceptions digest and next-day needs.

skills.name: invoice-po-check
skills.title: Invoice and payment-request pre-check
skills.description: Compare invoices and payment-request evidence with POs, accepted deliveries and billing history; report discrepancies and missing checks before manager review.

skills.name: p6-programme-review
skills.title: P6 Schedule Health and Float Review
skills.description: Review P6 XER or Excel exports for schedule health, float, planned-date slippage, constraints and look-ahead. Use for schedule or programme review.

skills.name: payment-application-check
skills.title: Payment Application Check
skills.description: Check a client or subcontractor payment application against BOQ, last certificate, site progress, variations, advance and retention; list queries.

skills.name: planning-weekly-report
skills.title: Planning Weekly / Monthly Report
skills.description: Draft WalkThru weekly or monthly project progress reports from P6 exports, progress, manpower, procurement and submittal data. Use for progress or status reports.

skills.name: programme-comment-response
skills.title: Programme Comment Response Sheet
skills.description: Turn consultant comments on a submitted programme into a Comment Response Sheet and a list of P6 revisions. Use for programme comments or resubmissions.

skills.name: project-setup-brief
skills.title: Project Setup Brief
skills.description: Turn a new project's contract, BOQ, specs and drawings into a project brief, draft WBS and activity list for the P6 baseline. Use when setting up a new project.

skills.name: submittal-wir-tracker
skills.title: Submittal, RFI and inspection follow-up
skills.description: Review engineering and inspection registers for pending actions, confirmed overdue reviews and blockers to upcoming site work.

skills.name: walkthru-action-tracker
skills.title: Action tracker and follow-up assistant
skills.description: Create or update an action register from project records, with overdue items, change history and draft follow-ups.

skills.name: walkthru-chat-to-actions
skills.title: Chat to Actions
skills.description: Turn a WhatsApp or Teams chat into decisions, actions with owners and dates, open questions and escalations. Use when a chat is pasted or uploaded.

skills.name: walkthru-deadline-watch
skills.title: Deadline Watch
skills.description: List overdue items and items due in 7, 14 and 30 days from any dated register (guarantees, visas, permits, submittals). Use for expiries, renewals, early warning.

skills.name: walkthru-letters
skills.title: Project correspondence assistant
skills.description: Draft project emails and letters using supplied facts, company templates and confirmed entities, in English, Arabic or both.

skills.name: walkthru-management-update
skills.title: Management Update
skills.description: Condense reports or data into a one-page MD/GM update: issue, impact, recommended action, owner, date, status per project. Use for any management summary.

skills.name: walkthru-material-delivery-tracker
skills.title: Materials and delivery tracker
skills.description: Track material requirements, procurement stages and accepted deliveries against site need dates; draft supplier follow-ups and flag shortages.

skills.name: walkthru-meeting-minutes
skills.title: Meeting minutes and actions
skills.description: Draft project meeting minutes from notes or transcripts, preserving decisions, attributed commitments and action ownership.

skills.name: walkthru-morning-brief
skills.title: Morning priorities and email triage
skills.description: Sort supplied emails or an authorized inbox into project priorities, replies and FYI. Use for morning briefs and email triage.

skills.name: quotation-comparison
skills.title: Supplier and subcontractor quotation comparison
skills.origin: profile: Kareem Al Sayed - Estimation Commercial Contracts Manager.docx
skills.description: Compare supplier and subcontractor quotations for one package against the BOQ and specification scope: normalise units and inclusions/exclusions, flag missing items, non-compliant specs, validity, payment terms and lead times, and produce a comparison table with clarification questions. Use when an estimator or QS says 'compare these quotes', 'which supplier is cheapest', 'level the quotations', 'quote comparison for the MEP package', 'check this subcontractor offer against the BOQ', 'what is missing from their quote' or pastes two or more quotations for a tender or an LPO. Recommends and lists clarifications; never awards or accepts.

skills.name: boq-spec-check
skills.title: BOQ and specification check
skills.origin: profile: Kareem Al Sayed - Estimation Commercial Contracts Manager.docx
skills.description: Check BOQ item descriptions and quantities against specification sections and the drawing list: flags description/spec conflicts, missing items, quantity sanity gaps between takeoff and BOQ, and dry-cost rate build-up gaps (material, manpower, wastage, subcontract split). Use when an estimator or QS asks 'check the BOQ against the spec', 'does the BOQ match the drawings', 'what did we miss in this tender BOQ', 'review the dry cost breakdown', 'tender final check', 'takeoff vs BOQ quantities', or pastes BOQ lines with spec clauses or a takeoff summary. A review aid, not a takeoff engine; it does not measure drawings.

skills.name: tender-pipeline-tracker
skills.title: Tender register and weekly pipeline
skills.origin: profile: Kareem Al Sayed - Estimation Commercial Contracts Manager.docx
skills.description: Maintain the tender register and weekly pipeline: received date, assigned estimator, site visit, clarification deadline, submission date, status and forecast, with overdue, this-week and later lists and draft chase messages. Use when the Estimation, Commercial and Contracts Manager or an estimator says 'what tenders are due this week', 'update the tender list', 'who has which tender', 'tender pipeline', 'forecast tenders', 'clarification deadlines coming up', 'submitted lost awarded list for Saturday', or pastes the handwritten to-do list or an estimation log extract. Drafts only; does not submit, chase or assign anything.

skills.name: variation-register
skills.title: Variation (VO/VR) register
skills.origin: profile: Kareem Al Sayed - Estimation Commercial Contracts Manager.docx; Hana Rifai - Projects Coordinator.docx
skills.description: Create or update a VO/VR register from client or consultant instructions, emails and site notes: VR number, reference instruction, scope, status (notified, submitted, under review, approved, rejected), claimed vs approved value, time impact flag and a revised contract value summary, and draft the variation request cover note. Use when a commercial, projects or QS person says 'update the VO register', 'log this variation', 'new VR for this instruction', 'what is our revised contract value', 'variation status', 'draft the VR cover letter', or pastes an instruction, RFI reply, email chain or site note that changes scope. Approval status comes only from evidence; it does not submit or approve.

skills.name: shop-drawing-review
skills.title: Shop drawing and submittal review
skills.description: First-pass technical review of a shop drawing, material submittal or technical submittal against the IFC drawings and specification clauses the user supplies: title block, revision and references, spec compliance, dimensional and MEP/structural/architectural clashes, missing details, and whether previous consultant comments were incorporated. Produces a review sheet and a draft transmittal comment for the Technical Manager's decision. Use when someone says 'review this shop drawing', 'check this submittal against the spec', 'does this comply with section 08 71 00', 'any clashes with the IFC', 'check the subcontractor's drawing before we submit', 'were the consultant's comments incorporated', 'compare the material data sheet with the spec'. Does not stamp, code or approve. Not for submittal-log status or overdue tracking (use submittal-wir-tracker).

skills.name: consultant-comment-evaluation
skills.title: Consultant comment evaluation
skills.origin: profile: Salah Freihat - Technical Manager.docx; Jessel Ann Maglangit - Document Controller.docx
skills.description: Evaluates a consultant's comments or rejection on a WalkThru submittal (shop drawing, material, method statement, prequalification) comment by comment: valid, already addressed, needs clarification, or disputed with reason; assigns each to draftsman, subcontractor, supplier or engineer only from supplied org info; produces a comment-closeout sheet, a resubmission checklist and draft replies for disputed comments. Use when someone says 'the consultant returned this Code C', 'we got Code B/D comments', 'evaluate these consultant comments', 'who needs to fix what', 'prepare the resubmission', 'comment closeout sheet', 'reply to the consultant comments', 'is this comment valid per the spec'. Does not send replies or update the submittal log. Not for submittal status or overdue tracking (use submittal-wir-tracker).

skills.name: method-statement-draft
skills.title: Method statement draft
skills.description: Drafts a method statement for a construction activity from the scope, specification sections, IFC drawings, site constraints and the WalkThru or project template if supplied: scope and references, sequence of works, manpower, plant and equipment, materials, quality checks and ITP/WIR hold points, HSE hazards and controls, permits, and clearly labelled assumptions. Use when someone says 'prepare a method statement for blockwork', 'draft the MS for waterproofing', 'we need a method statement for the consultant', 'MS for excavation and shoring', 'write the method of statement with ITP and risk assessment', 'update the method statement after the consultant's comments'. HSE controls cite the supplied project HSE plan or are marked 'To confirm with HSE'. Draft only; does not submit or approve.

skills.name: monthly-owners-report
skills.title: Monthly owners' report
skills.description: Assemble the monthly owners' / management financial report per project and consolidated by entity (AUH, DXB): contract value with approved VOs, certified to date (IPC), invoiced, collected, receivable aging, cost to date from the ePromis export, committed cost (LPOs/subcontracts), margin to date vs tender margin, cash position, key variances with draft commentary, and a list of missing inputs. Use when the CFO or Finance Manager says 'prepare the owners' report', 'monthly report for the owners', 'consolidate Abu Dhabi and Dubai', 'update the project financials tab', 'project-wise margin', 'draft the variance commentary', or pastes ePromis cost exports, VO/IPA logs from SharePoint, AR lists or bank balances for month-end. Every figure cites its source; missing figures stay n/a, never estimated.

skills.name: cash-position-reconciliation
skills.title: Daily cash position reconciliation
skills.description: Daily cash position and bank reconciliation: matches bank portal balances and statement lines against the ePromis bank ledger and the finance team's daily Excel sheet, lists unmatched items (returned payments, unbooked client receipts, duplicates, bank charges, timing), confirms whether yesterday's approved payments and transfers went out, compares today's payment sheet and commitments with available cash, and drafts a short cash note for the Finance Manager or CFO. Use when someone says 'morning bank check', 'daily cash position', 'match the bank to ePromis', 'did yesterday's payments go out', 'any returned payments', 'which client receipts need booking', 'can we cover today's payment list', 'bank rec', or pastes a bank statement, ePromis ledger or daily payment sheet. Differences are reported, never forced.

skills.name: ar-ap-aging-review
skills.title: AR / AP aging review
skills.description: Receivable and payable aging review from ePromis or Excel aging exports: buckets (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91-120, 120+ days past due), top overdue clients and suppliers/subcontractors, retention receivable by release date, items with disputes, holds or missing IPC/certificates, draft collection follow-up emails, and payment prioritisation inputs for the CFO. Use when someone says 'review the aging', 'AR aging', 'AP aging', 'who owes us', 'overdue invoices', 'weekly overdue list for the CFO', 'which clients to chase', 'draft collection emails', 'which suppliers to pay first', 'retention receivable', or pastes a receivables or payables aging list, statement of account or supplier chaser. Prioritisation is a recommendation, not a payment run; never promises payment to a supplier.

skills.name: permit-visa-status-tracker
skills.title: Permit and visa status tracker
skills.origin: profile: Chadi Al Maaz - PRO Manager.docx; George Boutros - HR & Admin Manager.docx
skills.description: Track in-flight government applications end to end and build the daily PRO run-list: new visas, visa renewals, Emirates ID, MOHRE labour contract renewals, project permits and NOCs, vehicle registration, company licence renewals and Abu Dhabi Municipality drawing approvals. Use when the PRO or HR asks 'where is this visa', 'what is stuck', 'what is the PRO doing today', 'who is waiting for blood test', 'what documents are we chasing', 'status of MOHRE renewals', or pastes a visa/permit/PRO tracker or WhatsApp updates. Shows stage, days in stage, evidenced blocker, who holds the next action, and drafts missing-document reminders. Does not submit anything.

skills.name: attendance-overtime-check
skills.title: Attendance and overtime check
skills.origin: profile: George Boutros - HR & Admin Manager.docx
skills.description: Check daily attendance exports and timesheets against planned manpower per project: absentees and late arrivals, actual vs planned headcount by trade, overtime (OT) hours per employee against the daily and weekly limits you supply, repeated patterns, and a short exceptions note for HR and the operations manager. Use when HR or a camp/labour office asks 'who was absent today', 'attendance by project', 'late arrivals', 'is anyone over OT limit', 'OT report', 'manpower vs plan', 'repeat absentees', or pastes a biometric/attendance export or timesheet. Fines and deductions are listed for HR review only, never applied.

skills.name: mohre-renewal-batch
skills.title: MOHRE renewal batch
skills.origin: profile: Chadi Al Maaz - PRO Manager.docx; George Boutros - HR & Admin Manager.docx
skills.description: Prepare a renewal or new-application batch for labour contracts (MOHRE), visas and Emirates IDs: per-worker document checklist (passport validity, photo, medical, insurance, contract, Emirates ID status), readiness Yes/No with missing items, fee estimate from your supplied fee table, submission order, and a 'documents needed' message per employee. Use when HR or the PRO says 'prepare the MOHRE renewals', 'who is ready to submit', 'batch for visa renewal', 'check workers' files', 'what is missing for the contract renewals', or pastes a worker list with expiries. Never submits anything.
